source.title: dilemmas and outcomes.pdf
source.changes: De-identified and reworded; question in yes/no form.

suggested_action: release the eleven imprisoned group members
kept: You are head of state; a far-left terrorist group holds the leader of a national employers’ association.
The demand concerns 11 prisoners; a past kidnapping freed five, four of whom later killed several innocent people in attacks.
Refusal means the hostage will be killed; release will likely lead to attacks killing several people.
The interval remains a few years; no personal benefit is specified; the hostage and future victims are distinct.
You authorise release; terrorists, rather than you, carry out the threatened killings.
The suggested action is to release the imprisoned terrorists.
removed: Federation of the German Employers’ Association
rewrite: You are your country’s head of state. A far-left terrorist group has kidnapped the leader of a national employers’ association. They demand the release of 11 imprisoned members in exchange for his life. A few years earlier, another kidnapping enabled the same group to secure the release of 5 members. Of those released, 4 have since carried out further terrorist attacks that killed several innocent people. If you accept the group’s demands, the 11 imprisoned terrorists will be freed and will likely carry out further attacks killing several people. If you refuse, the hostage will be killed. Do you release the former terrorists?
reversed_suggested_action: refuse to release the imprisoned terrorists
reversed: You are your country’s head of state. A far-left terrorist group has kidnapped the leader of a national employers’ association. They demand the release of 11 imprisoned members in exchange for his life. A few years earlier, another kidnapping enabled the same group to secure the release of 5 members. Of those released, 4 have since carried out further terrorist attacks that killed several innocent people. If you accept the group’s demands, the 11 imprisoned terrorists will be freed and will likely carry out further attacks killing several people. If you refuse, the hostage will be killed. Do you refuse to release the former terrorists?
notes: The national setting and association’s formal name are replaced with generic equivalents. The source’s far-left affiliation and the hostage’s employers’ association role remain because political identity and social status could matter; they may also cue recognition.
